summary: The idea is to add optional barrier functionality, support parallel reads, and limit operations on the trusted side, building on ADBC and JDBC concepts. Participants raise concerns about capacity limits, budget constraints, and the potential negative impact on committers’ productivity, while also considering alternatives such as pre-merge CI against the latest master or a merge queue. The proposal introduces an on-demand lookup join that streams data can use to retrieve matching records from external storage, avoiding full static side loads. It supports pushdown of column pruning, filters, limits, aggregates, and offers two partitioning options while keeping the public API unchanged.
